audit.why: Viktor controls early (melee Diana must walk into E range to CS), level 6 is a skill window, her first item is her spike, Viktor retakes at two items. Content layer and packet chart agree; 49.69% WR over 4635 games fits TRICKY.
Spikes correct: Viktor 3-5 dominance, level 6 skill test, Diana first item (shield + R resets), Viktor two items.

audit.why: Kit: Viktor E text = Hextech Ray; Diana Q 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, E Lunar Rush 22/20/18/16/14 (no CD vs Moonlight targets), R 100/90/80. Gravity Field is hardCC that interrupts dashes-in-progress only by stunning after lingering — advice kept as zone-the-commit.
audit.corrected: Names fixed, chart aligned to content/packet with whys rewritten, cooldown numbers added.

audit.why: Q 8s rank 1 is her poke/engage enabler; E 22s when unmarked is the punish window.
